bioIntro: As a Full-Stack Developer and Machine Learning Engineer, I build and maintain reliable software systems end to end — from clean, maintainable backends and DevOps pipelines to production machine learning models.
bioP2: My machine learning work follows CRISP-DM: leak-free preprocessing, benchmarking several algorithms instead of trusting a single one, and interpretability with SHAP so results stay explainable. My published research covers class-imbalance handling in YOLOv8 hand-fracture detection and web-integrated foot-arch detection. I hold the IBM Machine Learning and Introduction to Machine Learning specializations.
